answer: Sybil defense: per-identity proof-of-unique-work with escrowed refunds. At signup the chain whispers a fresh hash puzzle to each candidate, bound to its own public key, so no puzzle is reusable. Each solution is sealed with an ember - a fee burned at submission and refunded only after one hundred honest epochs. Long-tenured validators freeze into a tundra audit layer that samples proofs and seizes identities failing audit. An attacker running N puppets buys N puzzles, pays N ember fees, waits N refund clocks: linear cost, no bulk discount, while an honest agent pays once.
